nodes.label: Analysis
nodes.question: How does an integrative approach compare to a sector-based approach?
nodes.answer: An integrative approach that addresses multiple challenges is more likely to provide synergetic benefits compared to sector-based approaches that focus on only one challenge.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Clean water and sanitation|Emergency water supply and response|Cross-sectoral coordination_qna_001
nodes.label: Management
nodes.question: When might a sectoral approach be more effective?
nodes.answer: A sectoral approach might work better when the causes and effects of a problem are bound by one sector only.
